r1.title: Round 1
chips: Say yes to Round 2 at admission
who: Register, pay the Rs 3,000 counselling fee, pass the physical document check before choices, then fill and lock choices.

In 2025-26 (WBMCC's schedule of 26.11.2025): registration ran from 06.11.2025 to 09.11.2025 and again from 19.11.2025 to 20.11.2025; choices from 21.11.2025 to 24.11.2025; the result came on 27.11.2025; admission at the college ran on 28.11.2025 and from 01.12.2025 to 05.12.2025.
At admission you give an undertaking that you are not presently admitted anywhere through AIQ or state-quota counselling held in 2025 or earlier.

Allotted a seat outside your category (an unreserved seat, or a non-PwD seat) and can't show your caste or PwD certificate at admission: you are still admitted, as unreserved or non-PwD, and in Round 2 you can seek an upgrade only as that.

Allotted a seat of your own category (reserved or PwD) without a valid certificate: the seat is cancelled for that round and you count as unreserved or non-PwD; you go on to the next round only if you met that cut-off, otherwise you are out of the counselling. The PwD certificate must come from IPGMER Kolkata's medical board or a centre designated by MCC.

Registered as NRI by mistake: on that round's admission dates you can e-mail a signed request (PDF) to the Director of Medical Education, from the e-mail ID given for NEET, to have your registration reset, then register again and pay the counselling fee again; this works from the next round only, not in the stray round or after it.
opts: Pay the college's fee and give the bond at admission. You keep the seat and don't choose again in Round 2.

At admission you're asked whether you want Round 2. Only a yes printed on the admission slip keeps you in. With a yes you pay only the admission fees at the college; the bond or bank guarantee may wait for that round, but the course fee is due at the latest during Round 3's admission.

During the admission process of round 1, the allotted candidate shall be asked to provide willingness for participation in subsequent round at the allotted college. If the willingness is affirmative, this shall be mentioned clearly in the server generated admission slip and then only the candidate remains eligible to participate in round 2.
You go on to Round 2 without registering or paying again.
The Round 1 allotted but non-reported candidate is allowed to appear in Round 2 without fresh registration and without payment of fees for choice filling.

No penalty money, but you're out of the counselling. You apply in person at the college in WBMCC's time slot and must get the server-generated surrender letter; otherwise you stay on the college's admitted list.
The seat surrender of the admitted candidate during the process of Round 1 admission is allowed without any penalty money.

r2.title: Round 2
who: Round 1 joiners who said yes; the verified who weren't allotted or didn't fill choices in Round 1; Round 1 non-reporters (no fee); those whose Round 1 seat was cancelled for documents but who remain eligible; those who missed document verification (after paying again); fresh registrations.
Not those who joined in Round 1 without saying yes, or who surrendered a seat.

In 2025-26 (schedule of 26.11.2025, revised 17.12.2025): registration ran from 10.12.2025 to 13.12.2025; Round 1 admitted candidates could surrender their seats at the college on 18.12.2025; choices from 19.12.2025 to 21.12.2025; the result came on 24.12.2025; admission ran on 26.12.2025, 27.12.2025, 29.12.2025 and 30.12.2025.
opts: You lose any claim to the earlier seat. If you had joined it, the earlier college returns all the fees you paid, with your original documents and a server-generated relieving letter, before you join the new college.

The candidates who opt for up-gradation for the subsequent round/s, filled choice afresh in the subsequent round and upgraded accordingly as per the inter se merit, has no claim of the previously allotted seat.
You can enter Round 3 by paying the counselling fee again.
The non reported candidate in Round 2 allotted seat is allowed to appear in Round 3 without fresh registration but after payment of the counseling fees once again for choice filling.

Allowed, but you forfeit the admission fees and you're out of the counselling. You apply in person at the college in WBMCC's time slot and must get the server-generated surrender letter; otherwise you stay on the college's admitted list.
The seat surrender of the admitted candidate during the process of Round 2 admission is allowed but with forfeiture of admission fees.

r3.title: Round 3
who: The verified who were not allotted till Round 2 or didn't fill choices (no fee again); Round 2 joiners who said yes; Round 2 non-reporters (after paying the counselling fee again); those whose Round 2 seat was cancelled for documents but who remain eligible; fresh registrations.

In 2025-26 (revised schedules of 02.02.2026 and 10.02.2026): registration ran from 31.12.2025 to 02.01.2026, again from 27.01.2026 to 29.01.2026 and from 02.02.2026 to 04.02.2026; Round 2 admitted candidates could surrender their seats at the college on 30.01.2026, 31.01.2026, 03.02.2026 and 05.02.2026; choices from 07.02.2026 to 09.02.2026 and from 10.02.2026 to 12.02.2026; the result came on 16.02.2026; admission ran from 17.02.2026 to 19.02.2026.
opts: You stay out of later rounds and can't surrender the seat while counselling runs.
The seat surrender is not allowed from Round 3 counseling any further till the counseling process is over.
The candidate who remains not reported in Round 3 after allotment are not allowed any further in counseling process and they are out of the counseling process.

stray.title: Stray round
who: Fresh registration is open; registered candidates with no seat after Round 3 take part without paying again.

In 2025-26 (revised schedule of 10.02.2026): registration on 20.02.2026; choices from 21.02.2026 to 22.02.2026; the result came on 24.02.2026, with admission on 24.02.2026 and 25.02.2026. Seats left by candidates who didn't report were then allotted on the choices already made (result 27.02.2026; admission on 27.02.2026 and 28.02.2026).
opts: You can't surrender the seat, and there's no upgrade in this round.
Candidates who have admitted/joined the allotted seat in Online Stray Vacancy Round are not allowed to surrender their seats.
The candidates who remain not reported during Online Stray Vacancy Round counseling are out of the Counseling process.

after.title: Leaving the course
chips: Rs 5 lakh degree / Rs 2 lakh diploma
opts: From Round 3 on, a seat can't be surrendered until all rounds are over; after that, only by paying the bond penalty.
The seat surrender with payment of bond penalty is possible only after the counseling of all rounds are over for the session 2025-26.

Discontinuing the course at any time after admission, before it ends, costs Rs 5 lakh for a degree seat or Rs 2 lakh for a diploma seat. There is no discontinuation bond for DNB seats. Separately, open-category candidates who complete the course must serve the Government of West Bengal for 3 years (degree) or 2 years (diploma), or pay the penalty it fixes.
Discontinuation of course at any time after admission before completion of the course tenure will attract penalty of Rs. 5 lakhs for PG Medical Degree seats and Rs.2 lakhs for PG Diploma seats
gaps: whether the "bond penalty" for surrender is the Rs 5 lakh / Rs 2 lakh above.
how the discontinuation penalty fits with the free Round 1 surrender and the Round 2 surrender after admission (p.8).

reg: Rs 3,000 counselling fee, once, non-refundable. Paid again if you miss the document check, don't report in Round 2 and want Round 3, or ask to have your category or domicile status reset after failing verification (the earlier fee is then forfeited).
dep: No counselling security deposit is mentioned in the bulletin or the notices. At admission: a discontinuation bond of Rs 5 lakh (degree) or Rs 2 lakh (diploma) in Government colleges; private, trust and central colleges ask for a bond or a bank guarantee, as each college requires.
back: Counselling fee: only a duplicate payment, after the usual reconciliation time. If you joined a college and a later round gives you a new one, the earlier college returns all the fees you paid, with your original documents and a relieving letter.
leave: Discontinuing: Rs 5 lakh (degree) or Rs 2 lakh (diploma); no bond for DNB. After the course, open candidates serve 3 years (degree) or 2 years (diploma), or pay a penalty.
